trust_decision.summary: A caller may read a contributor's profile only for its own GitHub session login, and no MCP tool result may carry miner wallet or per-day earnings fields; decided in the HTTP profile handler, the MCP profile tool, and the shared MCP result serializer.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the profile endpoint first; this handler returns buildContributorProfile(...) whose gittensor block carries hotkey, alphaPerDay, taoPerDay and usdPerDay straight from the official miner snapshot, and it is the only /v1/contributors route with no requireContributorAccess call.

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP CallTool result wrapper toolResult (src/mcp/server.ts:1074) shared by every gittensory_* tool

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Only logins listed in ADMIN_GITHUB_LOGINS may reach /v1/* at all (canSessionAccessPath at src/api/routes.ts:2643), and static operator tokens are deliberately exempt from the check (src/api/routes.ts:2681, asserted at test/integration/routes-errors.test.ts:174-176), so a caller who can read another contributor's profile is already a trusted admin/operator; decision packs are likewise private to the contributor, so their officialStats may keep that contributor's own earnings.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Static operator tokens (GITTENSORY_API_TOKEN / GITTENSORY_MCP_TOKEN, identity kind "static") must keep reading any contributor's contributor-scoped data - requireContributorAccess only enforces for kind "session" and the pinned suite asserts a static-token open-pr-monitor for a victim returns 200; tightening the shared helper to cover static identities breaks that path and every other guarded route. A second adjacent must-keep is that the owner's own profile and the decision-pack officialStats keep alphaPerDay/taoPerDay/usdPerDay (ContributorProfileSchema declares them as required numbers and officialStats is typed Omit<...,"hotkey"> and asserted to survive minus hotkey at test/integration/api.test.ts:601), so redacting at the shared profile builder rather than at the MCP output breaks the documented profile contract.

O6_input_shapes: camelCase key names alphaPerDay / taoPerDay / usdPerDay, matched anywhere in the tree
nested object: profile.gittensor (and decision-pack profile.officialStats), not just top-level keys
arrays of objects (repositories, pullRequests) walked recursively by redactSensitiveForMcp
the same payload rendered twice - structuredContent and JSON.stringify text inside content[0].text
the existing secret key set hotkey / coldkey / wallet / private_key / privateKey / mnemonic widened in place
same profile body on two surfaces: HTTP route (guard only, values kept) vs MCP tool (guard and values stripped)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a shareable / maintainer-facing pack variant that reuses profile.officialStats instead of the private pack
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the project already keeps a public-safe packet and public-comment path next to private packs, so a maintainer-shareable pack built from the same officialStats block is a natural next feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: add alphaPerDay/taoPerDay/usdPerDay to the public-comment forbidden-term list
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: this list and the text guard at src/signals/engine.ts:3304 already gate wallet/hotkey/reward wording for public GitHub output, just without the earnings key names.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: redact earnings keys in the packaged CLI's own output redaction
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the npm package keeps an independent redaction regex for everything it prints, so a maintainer adding earnings redaction there is plausible and would not be noticed by the server-side fix.

O9_family: improper access control (CWE-284: missing contributor-scoped authorization) with information exposure of miner financial fields through a serializer

O10_build.toolchain: npm 10.9.2, Node >=22, TypeScript 5.9, wrangler 4, vitest 4 (node environment, test/stubs for cloudflare:workers and cloudflare:email)
O10_build.project_tests: test/integration/routes-errors.test.ts (contributor-scope guard matrix, lines 123-200), test/integration/api.test.ts (decision-pack and MCP redaction, lines 575-607), test/unit/decision-pack.test.ts (sanitizeOfficialStats); createTestEnv uses an in-process TestD1Database and a no-op Queue so no network or external service is needed.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the MCP guard and extend the existing hotkey regex inside getContributorProfile's own result instead of the shared toolResult serializer, leaving other tools' payloads and sanitizeOfficialStats untouched.
